cond_0001.intro: As a Shift Equipment Engineer at [Company name masked] in [Location masked], you are responsible for monitoring, sustaining, and improving the equipment and/or processes, while working in partnership with production team members and area engineers. In this position you will supervise tool performance, schedule and perform preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and use mechanical, electronic and PC/software skills to solve and repair equipment issues. They are also required to assist with equipment installs, engineering tests, build and modify equipment procedures, increase tool uptime through systematic problem solving and quality workmanship, and thoroughly document all maintenance.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Completes all required safety training and conducts all work in accordance with safety policies. Creates and maintains a safe work environment. Performs safety audits and walkthroughs. Consistently supports established safety and quality processes. Participates in Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions. Contributes to continuous improvement and problem-solving efforts. Identifies and helps resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensures the quality of task updates and passdowns. Manages queue time alerts and helps coordinate when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Works efficiently, collaborates with all areas and work functions. Partners with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to implement daily activities to resolve issues that could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Collaborates with leaders on improvement opportunities to construct personal performance and development goals. Provides clear written communication. Ensures pass down communications are updated and accurately reflects the work performed and tool current statuses. Ensures maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Ability to solve equipment and process issues and enable manufacturing development. Provide mentorship to peers and resolve highly technical equipment issues. Drive root cause analysis to permanent prevention. Improve overall equipment effectiveness withing the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Partner with teammates to eliminate defects and create continuous improvement projects. Analyze data with SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Effectively manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Lead continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Collaborate with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and run projects. Lead projects to ensure objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule and budget. Track actions and provide solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Strong project management skills.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or an AS degree with 5+ years of semiconductor confirmed experience.
Proficient in electrical, vacuum, gas flow and mechanical fundamentals including skilled at using schematic diagrams to fix systems to components level.
Ability to learn area equipment including knowledge of process recipes.
Firm understanding on how the equipment is designed to process.
Strong time management, organization, prioritization and communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
Intermediate to advanced software skills, i.e. Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, Jmp, Solidworks, and Autocad.
Intermediate understanding of the Fab process areas and including area processing equipment and supporting systems.

cond_0028.intro: As a Shift Equipment Engineer at [Company name masked] in [Location masked], you are responsible for monitoring, sustaining, and improving the equipment and/or processes, while working in partnership with production team members and area engineers. In this position you will supervise tool performance, schedule and perform preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and use mechanical, electronic and PC/software skills to solve and repair equipment issues. Safety & Quality

Consistently supports established safety and quality processes. Participates in Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions. Contributes to continuous improvement and problem-solving efforts. Identifies and helps resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensures the quality of task updates and passdowns. Manages queue time alerts and helps coordinate when to stop/start lot ordering.

Works efficiently, collaborates with all areas and work functions. Ensures pass down communications are updated and accurately reflects the work performed and tool current statuses. Ensures maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Ability to solve equipment and process issues and enable manufacturing development. Provide mentorship to peers and resolve highly technical equipment issues. Drive root cause analysis to permanent prevention. Improve overall equipment effectiveness withing the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Partner with teammates to eliminate defects and create continuous improvement projects. Analyze data with SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Effectively manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.

Lead continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Collaborate with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and run projects. Lead projects to ensure objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule and budget. Track actions and provide solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Strong project management skills.

cond_0045.intro: As a Shift Equipment Engineer at [Company name masked] in [Location masked], you will work in partnership with production team members and area engineers to monitor, sustain, and improve equipment and processes. In this role, you will coordinate tool performance, schedule and carry out preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and work alongside colleagues to troubleshoot and repair equipment issues using mechanical, electronic, and PC/software skills. You will also help with equipment installs, support engineering tests, collaborate on building and modifying equipment procedures, and contribute to increasing tool uptime through systematic problem solving and thorough documentation.
cond_0045.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Complete all required safety training and carry out all work in accordance with safety policies. Help maintain a safe work environment. Participate in safety audits and walkthroughs. Support established safety and quality processes. Contribute to Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions alongside the team. Help identify and resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensure the quality of task updates and passdowns. Coordinate queue time alerts and work with others to determine when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Work alongside colleagues across all areas and work functions. Coordinate with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to carry out daily activities that address issues which could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Work with leaders on improvement opportunities to build personal performance and development goals. Provide clear written communication. Keep passdown communications updated so they accurately reflect work performed and current tool statuses. Ensure maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Work with the team to solve equipment and process issues and support manufacturing development. Share knowledge with peers and help resolve highly technical equipment issues. Collaborate on root cause analysis to reach permanent prevention. Support overall equipment effectiveness within the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Partner with teammates to eliminate defects and develop continuous improvement projects. Analyze data using SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Help manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Coordinate continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Work with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and run projects. Help ensure project objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule, and budget. Track actions and provide solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Apply strong project management skills throughout.
cond_0045.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, OR an AS degree with 5+ years of confirmed semiconductor experience
Proficient in electrical, vacuum, gas flow, and mechanical fundamentals, including skilled use of schematic diagrams to troubleshoot systems to component level
Ability to learn area equipment including knowledge of process recipes
Solid understanding of how equipment is designed to process
Strong time management, organization, prioritization, and communication skills
Preferred Requirements
Intermediate to advanced software skills, e.g. Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, JMP, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD
Intermediate understanding of Fab process areas including area processing equipment and supporting systems

In this position you will supervise tool performance, schedule and perform preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and use mechanical, electronic and PC/software skills to solve and repair equipment issues. You will also lead equipment installs, engineering tests, build and modify equipment procedures, drive tool uptime through systematic problem solving and quality workmanship, and thoroughly document all maintenance.

Safety & Quality
Complete all required safety training and conduct all work in accordance with safety policies. Own a safe work environment. Execute safety audits and walkthroughs. Consistently uphold established safety and quality processes. Lead Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions. Drive continuous improvement and problem-solving efforts. Ensure pass down communications are updated and accurately reflect the work performed and tool current statuses. Ensure maintenance and work is completed and tracked to high quality standards.

Improve overall equipment effectiveness within the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Lead teammates to eliminate defects and create continuous improvement projects. Analyze data with SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.

Lead continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Direct collaboration with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and execute projects. Strong project management skills.

Proficient in electrical, vacuum, gas flow and mechanical fundamentals including skilled at using schematic diagrams to fix systems to components level. In this position you will supervise tool performance, schedule and perform preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and use mechanical, electronic and PC/software skills to solve and repair equipment issues. You are also required to assist with equipment installs, engineering tests, build and modify equipment procedures, increase tool uptime through systematic problem solving and quality workmanship, and thoroughly document all maintenance.
cond_0061.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Completes all required safety training and conducts all work in accordance with safety policies. Creates and maintains a safe work environment. Performs safety audits and walkthroughs. Consistently supports established safety and quality processes. Participates in Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions. Contributes to continuous improvement and problem-solving efforts. Identifies and helps resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensures the quality of task updates and passdowns. Manages queue time alerts and helps coordinate when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Works efficiently and coordinates with all areas and work functions as tasks require. Coordinates with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to implement daily activities that resolve issues which could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Provides input to leaders on improvement opportunities to support personal performance and development goals. Provides clear written communication. Ensures pass down communications are updated and accurately reflect the work performed and current tool statuses. Ensures maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Solves equipment and process issues and enables manufacturing development. Provides technical guidance to peers and resolves highly technical equipment issues. Drives root cause analysis to permanent prevention. Improves overall equipment effectiveness within the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Works with teammates to eliminate defects and develop continuous improvement projects. Analyzes data with SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Manages equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Leads continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Coordinates with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and run projects. Leads projects to ensure objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule and budget. Tracks actions and provides solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Strong project management skills.
cond_0061.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or an AS degree with 5+ years of confirmed semiconductor experience
Proficient in electrical, vacuum, gas flow, and mechanical fundamentals, including skilled use of schematic diagrams to troubleshoot systems to component level
Ability to learn area equipment including knowledge of process recipes
Firm understanding of how equipment is designed to process
Strong time management, organization, and prioritization skills
Preferred Requirements
Intermediate to advanced software skills, e.g. Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, JMP, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD
Intermediate understanding of Fab process areas including area processing equipment and supporting systems
Strong written and verbal communication skills

In this position you will supervise tool performance, schedule and perform preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and use mechanical, electronic and PC/software skills to solve and repair equipment issues. You are also required to assist with equipment installs, engineering tests, build and modify equipment procedures, increase tool uptime through systematic problem solving and quality workmanship, and thoroughly document all maintenance.
cond_0097.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Completes all required safety training and conducts all work in accordance with safety policies. Creates and maintains a safe work environment. Performs safety audits and walkthroughs. Consistently supports established safety and quality processes. Participates in Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions. Contributes to continuous improvement and problem-solving efforts. Identifies and helps resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensures the quality of task updates and passdowns. Manages queue time alerts and helps coordinate when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Works efficiently and coordinates with all areas and work functions as tasks require. Coordinates with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to implement daily activities that resolve issues which could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Provides input to leaders on improvement opportunities to support personal performance and development goals. Provides clear written communication. Ensures pass down communications are updated and accurately reflect the work performed and current tool statuses. Ensures maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Solves equipment and process issues and enables manufacturing development. Provides technical guidance to peers and resolves highly technical equipment issues. Drives root cause analysis to permanent prevention. Improves overall equipment effectiveness within the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Works with teammates to eliminate defects and develop continuous improvement projects. Analyzes data with SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Manages equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Leads continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Coordinates with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and run projects. Leads projects to ensure objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule and budget. Tracks actions and provides solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Strong project management skills.
cond_0097.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or an AS degree with 5+ years of confirmed semiconductor experience
Proficient in electrical, vacuum, gas flow, and mechanical fundamentals, including skilled use of schematic diagrams to troubleshoot systems to component level
Ability to learn area equipment including knowledge of process recipes
Firm understanding of how equipment is designed to process
Strong time management, organization, and prioritization skills
Preferred Requirements
Intermediate to advanced software skills, e.g. Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, JMP, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD
Intermediate understanding of Fab process areas including area processing equipment and supporting systems
Strong written and verbal communication skills

cond_0116.intro: As a Shift Equipment Engineer at [Company name masked] in [Location masked], you are responsible for monitoring, sustaining, and improving the equipment and/or processes, while working in partnership with production team members and area engineers. In this position you will own tool performance, schedule and execute preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and apply mechanical, electronic and PC/software skills to diagnose and repair equipment issues. You are also expected to lead equipment installs, drive engineering tests, build and modify equipment procedures, increase tool uptime through systematic problem solving and quality workmanship, and thoroughly document all maintenance.
cond_0116.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Complete all required safety training and conduct all work in accordance with safety policies. Maintain a safe work environment. Execute safety audits and walkthroughs. Consistently uphold established safety and quality processes. Drive Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions. Lead continuous improvement and problem-solving efforts. Identify and resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensure the quality of task updates and passdowns. Manage queue time alerts and determine when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Collaborate with all areas and work functions. Partner with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to execute daily activities and resolve issues that could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Engage with leaders on improvement opportunities to set personal performance and development goals. Deliver clear written communication. Ensure pass down communications are updated and accurately reflect the work performed and current tool statuses. Ensure maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Solve equipment and process issues and enable manufacturing development. Provide mentorship to peers and resolve highly technical equipment issues. Drive root cause analysis to permanent prevention. Improve overall equipment effectiveness within the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Work with teammates to eliminate defects and lead continuous improvement projects. Analyze data with SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Lead continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Engage with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and execute projects. Own projects to ensure objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule and budget. Track actions and deliver solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time.
cond_0116.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, OR an AS degree with 5+ years of semiconductor experience
Proficient in electrical, vacuum, gas flow and mechanical fundamentals, including skilled at using schematic diagrams to fix systems to component level
Ability to learn area equipment including knowledge of process recipes
Firm understanding of how the equipment is designed to process
Strong time management, organization, prioritization and communication skills
Preferred Requirements
Intermediate to advanced software skills, i.e. Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, JMP, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD
Intermediate understanding of the Fab process areas including area processing equipment and supporting systems

They are also required to assist with equipment installs, engineering tests, build and modify equipment procedures, increase tool uptime through systematic problem solving and quality workmanship, and thoroughly document all maintenance.
cond_0218.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Completes all required safety training and conducts all work in accordance with safety policies. Creates and maintains a safe work environment. Performs safety audits and walkthroughs. Consistently supports established safety and quality processes. Participates in Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions. Contributes to continuous improvement and problem-solving efforts. Identifies and helps resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensures the quality of task updates and passdowns. Manages queue time alerts and helps coordinate when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Works efficiently at a world class level, collaborates with all areas and work functions. Partners with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to implement daily activities to resolve issues that could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Collaborates with leaders on improvement opportunities to construct personal performance and development goals. Provides clear written communication. Ensures pass down communications are updated and accurately reflects the work performed and tool current statuses. Ensures maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Ability to solve equipment and process issues and enable manufacturing development. Provide mentorship to peers and resolve highly technical equipment issues. Drive root cause analysis to permanent prevention. Improve overall equipment effectiveness withing the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Partner with teammates to eliminate defects and create continuous improvement projects. Analyze data with SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Effectively manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Lead continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Collaborate with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and run projects. Lead projects to ensure objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule and budget. Track actions and provide solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Strong project management skills.
cond_0218.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering; advanced degree strongly preferred. Alternatively, an AS degree accompanied by a minimum of 5 years of demonstrated semiconductor expertise.
Deep knowledge of electrical, vacuum, gas flow, and mechanical fundamentals, including strong command of schematic diagrams to diagnose and repair systems to the component level.
Advanced software expertise across tools such as Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, JMP, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD.
Proven track record of learning and operating area equipment, with advanced knowledge of process recipes and how equipment is designed to process.
Preferred Requirements
Solid understanding of Fab process areas, including area processing equipment and supporting systems.
Exceptional time management, organization, prioritization, and communication skills.

Safety & Quality

Lead continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Engage with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and execute projects. You will also help with equipment installs, support engineering tests, collaborate on building and modifying equipment procedures, and contribute to increasing tool uptime through systematic problem solving and thorough documentation.
cond_0333.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Complete all required safety training and carry out all work in accordance with safety policies. Help maintain a safe work environment. Participate in safety audits and walkthroughs. Support established safety and quality processes. Contribute to Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions alongside the team. Help identify and resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensure the quality of task updates and passdowns. Coordinate queue time alerts and work with others to determine when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Work alongside colleagues across all areas and work functions. Coordinate with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to carry out daily activities that address issues which could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Work with leaders on improvement opportunities to build personal performance and development goals. Provide clear written communication. Keep passdown communications updated so they accurately reflect work performed and current tool statuses. Ensure maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Work with the team to solve equipment and process issues and support manufacturing development. Share knowledge with peers and help resolve highly technical equipment issues. Collaborate on root cause analysis to reach permanent prevention. Support overall equipment effectiveness within the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Partner with teammates to eliminate defects and develop continuous improvement projects. Analyze data using SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Help manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Coordinate continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Work with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and run projects. Help ensure project objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule, and budget. Track actions and provide solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Apply strong project management skills throughout.
cond_0333.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, OR an AS degree with 5+ years of confirmed semiconductor experience
Proficient in electrical, vacuum, gas flow, and mechanical fundamentals, including skilled use of schematic diagrams to troubleshoot systems to component level
Ability to learn area equipment including knowledge of process recipes
Solid understanding of how equipment is designed to process
Strong time management, organization, prioritization, and communication skills
Preferred Requirements
Intermediate to advanced software skills, e.g. Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, JMP, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD
Intermediate understanding of Fab process areas including area processing equipment and supporting systems
cond_0333.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0333.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.

cond_0387.intro: As a Shift Equipment Engineer at [Company name masked] in [Location masked], you will work in partnership with production team members and area engineers to monitor, sustain, and improve equipment and processes. In this role, you will coordinate tool performance, schedule and carry out preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and work alongside colleagues to troubleshoot and repair equipment issues using mechanical, electronic, and PC/software skills. You will also help with equipment installs, support engineering tests, collaborate on building and modifying equipment procedures, and contribute to increasing tool uptime through systematic problem solving and thorough documentation.
cond_0387.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Complete all required safety training and carry out all work in accordance with safety policies. Help maintain a safe work environment. Participate in safety audits and walkthroughs. Support established safety and quality processes. Contribute to Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions alongside the team. Help identify and resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensure the quality of task updates and passdowns. Coordinate queue time alerts and work with others to determine when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Work alongside colleagues across all areas and work functions. Coordinate with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to carry out daily activities that address issues which could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Work with leaders on improvement opportunities to build personal performance and development goals. Provide clear written communication. Keep passdown communications updated so they accurately reflect work performed and current tool statuses. Ensure maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Work with the team to solve equipment and process issues and support manufacturing development. Share knowledge with peers and help resolve highly technical equipment issues. Collaborate on root cause analysis to reach permanent prevention. Support overall equipment effectiveness within the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Partner with teammates to eliminate defects and develop continuous improvement projects. Analyze data using SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Help manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Coordinate continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Work with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and run projects. Help ensure project objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule, and budget. Track actions and provide solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Apply strong project management skills throughout.
cond_0387.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, OR an AS degree with 5+ years of confirmed semiconductor experience
Proficient in electrical, vacuum, gas flow, and mechanical fundamentals, including skilled use of schematic diagrams to troubleshoot systems to component level
Ability to learn area equipment including knowledge of process recipes
Solid understanding of how equipment is designed to process
Strong time management, organization, prioritization, and communication skills
Preferred Requirements
Intermediate to advanced software skills, e.g. Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, JMP, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD
Intermediate understanding of Fab process areas including area processing equipment and supporting systems

In this position you will supervise tool performance, schedule and perform preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and use mechanical, electronic and PC/software skills to solve and repair equipment issues. They are also required to assist with equipment installs, engineering tests, build and modify equipment procedures, increase tool uptime through systematic problem solving and quality workmanship, and thoroughly document all maintenance.
cond_0516.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Completes all required safety training and conducts all work in accordance with safety policies. Creates and maintains a safe work environment. Performs safety audits and walkthroughs. Consistently supports established safety and quality processes. Participates in Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions. Contributes to continuous improvement and problem-solving efforts. Identifies and helps resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensures the quality of task updates and passdowns. Manages queue time alerts and helps coordinate when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Works efficiently at a world class level, collaborates with all areas and work functions. Partners with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to implement daily activities to resolve issues that could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Collaborates with leaders on improvement opportunities to construct personal performance and development goals. Provides clear written communication. Ensures pass down communications are updated and accurately reflects the work performed and tool current statuses. Ensures maintenance and work is effectively completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Ability to solve equipment and process issues and enable manufacturing development. Provide mentorship to peers and resolve highly technical equipment issues. Drive root cause analysis to permanent prevention. Improve overall equipment effectiveness withing the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Partner with teammates to eliminate defects and create continuous improvement projects. Analyze data with SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Effectively manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Lead continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Collaborate with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and run projects. Lead projects to ensure objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule and budget. Track actions and provide solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Strong project management skills.
cond_0516.requirements: BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; or an AS degree accompanied by around 5 or more years of semiconductor experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Working knowledge of electrical, vacuum, gas flow and mechanical fundamentals, including comfort using schematic diagrams to troubleshoot systems to component level. Familiarity with software tools such as Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, Jmp, Solidworks, and Autocad — candidates who are still building proficiency in some of these are welcome to apply. Ability to learn area equipment including knowledge of process recipes. Background in how equipment is designed to process. Some exposure to Fab process areas, including area processing equipment and supporting systems. Ability to manage time, stay organized, and communicate clearly — these skills can be developed further in the role.
cond_0516.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0611.intro: As a Shift Equipment Engineer at [Company name masked] in [Location masked], you are responsible for monitoring, sustaining, and improving the equipment and/or processes, while working in partnership with production team members and area engineers. In this position you will supervise tool performance, schedule and perform preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and use mechanical, electronic and PC/software skills to solve and repair equipment issues. You will also lead equipment installs, engineering tests, build and modify equipment procedures, drive tool uptime through systematic problem solving and quality workmanship, and thoroughly document all maintenance.
cond_0611.responsibilities:
Safety & Quality
Complete all required safety training and conduct all work in accordance with safety policies. Own a safe work environment. Execute safety audits and walkthroughs. Consistently uphold established safety and quality processes. Lead Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) actions. Drive continuous improvement and problem-solving efforts. Identify and resolve training opportunities or procedure gaps. Ensure the quality of task updates and passdowns. Manage queue time alerts and determine when to stop/start lot ordering.
Communication & Teamwork
Deliver results efficiently, coordinating across all areas and work functions. Lead daily activities with 1st Shift Engineers and Shift Engineers/Technicians to resolve issues that could cause yield loss, excursions, defects, tool restrictions, or output loss. Drive improvement opportunities with leaders to set personal performance and development goals. Provide clear written communication. Ensure pass down communications are updated and accurately reflect the work performed and tool current statuses. Ensure maintenance and work is completed and tracked to high quality standards.
Technical/Data Analysis
Solve equipment and process issues and enable manufacturing development. Provide mentorship to peers and resolve highly technical equipment issues. Drive root cause analysis to permanent prevention. Improve overall equipment effectiveness within the Total Productive Maintenance culture. Lead teammates to eliminate defects and create continuous improvement projects. Analyze data with SPC principles to improve process controls and reduce defectivity baselines. Manage equipment SPC performance to enable more effective equipment processing.
Project Management/Planning
Lead continuous improvement projects including everyday activities at [Company name masked]. Direct collaboration with equipment owners to develop, prioritize, and execute projects. Own projects to ensure objectives are completed within the required scope, schedule and budget. Track actions and deliver solution paths or resources to ensure actions are completed on time. Strong project management skills.
cond_0611.requirements: BS degree in a related technical field such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering OR an AS degree accompanied by 5+ years of semiconductor confirmed experience. Proficient in electrical, vacuum, gas flow and mechanical fundamentals including skilled at using schematic diagrams to fix systems to components level. Intermediate to advanced software skills, i.e. Python, Java, Tableau, Matlab, MS Office Suite, Jmp, Solidworks, and Autocad. Ability to learn area equipment including knowledge of process recipes. Firm understanding on how the equipment is designed to process. Intermediate understanding of the Fab process areas and including area processing equipment and supporting systems. Strong time management, organization, prioritization and communication skills.
